reply:
<a2ui>
progress_store_connector = progress_store(course_id="vocab-flashcards")

cards_data = [
  {front: "Serendipity", back: "The occurrence of events by chance in a happy or beneficial way"},
  {front: "Ephemeral", back: "Lasting for a very short time"},
  {front: "Ubiquitous", back: "Present, appearing, or found everywhere"},
  {front: "Eloquent", back: "Fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing"},
  {front: "Pragmatic", back: "Dealing with things in a practical, realistic way based on actual circumstances"},
  {front: "Melancholy", back: "A feeling of pensive sadness, typically with no obvious cause"},
  {front: "Benevolent", back: "Kind and generous; showing goodwill"},
  {front: "Cacophony", back: "A harsh, discordant mixture of sounds"},
  {front: "Diligent", back: "Having or showing care in one's work or duties"},
  {front: "Nostalgia", back: "Sentimental longing for the past, typically for a period or place with happy associations"}
]

flashcard_section = flashcard_deck(
  cards=cards_data,
  accent="#4f46e5",
  label_front="TERM",
  label_back="DEFINITION"
)

progress_indicator = pull_stat(
  value="0",
  label="Flashcards Reviewed",
  unit="/ 10"
)

root = columns(
  cols=1,
  items=[
    {blocks: [heading("Vocabulary Flashcards")]},
    {blocks: [progress_indicator]},
    {blocks: [flashcard_section]}
  ]
)
</a2ui>
